title: Complete admin approval logic and add 'Entered By' column to all entry tables

requirements.text: Complete the admin approval workflow in the backend: add a function to list all pending users awaiting approval, ensure approve and reject functions work correctly, and migrate any existing users without a verified status to a default 'pending' or 'verified' state as appropriate.

quotes: admin approval logic (listing pending users, approving/rejecting, and migrating existing users to verified) may need a bit more work

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query to return all users with a pending approval status
Approve and reject functions update the user's approval status correctly and persist the change
Existing users without an approval status are migrated to an appropriate default status on upgrade
Migration logic is placed in migration.mo

requirements.text: Update the VerificationTab component to correctly fetch and display the list of pending users using the completed backend query from REQ-1, showing each user's name, principal/ID, and current status with Approve/Reject action buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: VerificationTab fetches and displays all users with pending approval status
Each row shows the user's name, identifier, and status
Approve and Reject buttons trigger the correct backend calls and refresh the list on success

requirements.text: Track the authenticated caller's principal (or display name) when a new entry is created for Income, Expenses, Inventory, Sales, Attendance, and Customers records. Store this 'enteredBy' field in each record's data type in the backend.

quotes: create a column to show the user that enter an entry

acceptanceCriteria: Each entry type (income, expense, inventory item, sale, attendance, customer) includes an 'enteredBy' field storing the caller's principal or resolved display name
The 'enteredBy' field is automatically set to the calling user's identity when a new record is created
Existing records without this field are handled gracefully (e.g., display 'Unknown')

requirements.text: Add an 'Entered By' column to the data tables in IncomeTab, ExpenseTab, InventoryTab, SalesTab, AttendanceTab, and CustomersTab. Display the name or identifier of the user who created each record.

quotes: create a column to show the user that enter an entry

acceptanceCriteria: Each of the listed tabs has an 'Entered By' column in its table
The column displays the name or principal of the user who created the record
Records without an 'enteredBy' value display 'Unknown' or a suitable fallback
The column is responsive and does not break the existing table layout

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Migration logic for state changes must be placed in backend/migration.mo
nonGoals: Redesigning the visual theme or layout of any tab
Adding role-based permissions beyond the existing admin/user distinction
Audit logging or change history beyond the initial 'entered by' field
